# A stopping rule for a pilot

The repair table trial has no condition under which we would stop it. Every problem becomes a reason to extend the pilot and gather more information. Write down a budget, a date and what would count as sufficient learning. [[Repair ideas]] should not become a permanent obligation merely because volunteers are reluctant to disappoint visitors.
